title: What are API Calls?
overview: API calls allow a React Native application to communicate with external servers and exchange data. They are commonly used to fetch, send, update, and delete information from a backend.

example.title: Real World Examples
example.content:
API Usage:
• Login authentication
• Fetching user profiles
• Loading product lists
• Sending form data

title: HTTP Methods
overview: HTTP methods define the type of operation performed between the application and the server. Different methods are used for different data operations.

example.title: Common HTTP Methods
example.content:
GET - Fetch data
POST - Create new data
PUT - Update existing data
DELETE - Remove data

title: Using Fetch API
overview: Fetch API is a built-in JavaScript method used to make network requests. It allows React Native applications to communicate with APIs and receive responses.

title: Using Axios for API Requests
overview: Axios is a popular library used for making API requests. It provides simpler syntax, automatic JSON handling, and better error handling compared to Fetch.

title: Handling API Response
overview: After an API request is completed, the application receives a response. Developers need to handle success responses, errors, and loading states properly.

example.title: Response Handling
example.content:
API States:
• Loading
• Success
• Error
• Empty Data

title: Async Await with API Calls
overview: Async await provides a cleaner way to handle asynchronous API operations. It makes API code easier to read compared to multiple promise chains.

example.title: Async Await Example

title: API Calls with useEffect
overview: useEffect is commonly used to perform API calls when a component loads. It allows fetching data automatically when the screen is opened.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how API calls work, HTTP methods, Fetch and Axios usage, handling responses, using async await, and integrating API calls with React Native components.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ APIs connect apps with servers.
✔ GET fetches data.
✔ POST sends data.
✔ Axios simplifies requests.
✔ Async await handles API operations.
